note: Per BoltBeam target backend: the tinygrad devices the kernel search may serve on it, in order (the provider's capability action says which open), and the environment the matched whole-model A/B runs with. A new backend is a row here, never a branch in code.

Metal.decode_env_why: The fork's default Metal replay cannot encode Qwen3-8B decode (an ICB offset over 32 bits); the fork's own EXP switch direct-encodes those calls. Both A/B arms run with it, so the comparison stays matched.

CUDA.decode_env_why: No switch: the fork's NV runtime replays the 8B decode as built.
